draft.subject: A quick first step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Following up on my welcome note from last week. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project with a few real tasks is usually the fastest way to see whether it fits how Willow Works works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
